status: frozen before any reader output for this new crop; root approval required before inference
scope: public PHerc0841 known labelled sheet, spatially distinct same-sheet audit; not independent scroll or sheet
selection: label counts and original geometry only. Initial source label-density grid search was blocked by coarse native matching. Continuous geometry diagnostic motivated a separately tested schema2 matching amendment, without reader-output inspection. See selection-rule-v1.json, selection-rule.json and selection-diagnostic.json for the complete selection history.

label_metadata.alignment: existing kit.auc.labels_on_map uniform nearest-center resize on published w00 source canvas

label_readout.primary: After the frozen label-free winner/acceptance search finishes, compare final combined rerender with baseline on the SAME w00 supervised inner64 pixels. Include legitimate quantized zeros in AUC (keep_zero=True), since this dense crop geometry and all completed inference tiles supply explicit coverage. Preserve supervision and confirmed-background distinction.
label_readout.secondary: Report all baseline/candidate forward/reverse/shuffle AUCs and high-pass label correlations descriptively after acceptance is frozen. Candidate label scores may not choose an offset, winner or threshold.
label_readout.coverage: Report expected/completed maps, common supervised ink/background pixels, zeros, corrected vs unchanged pixels, geometry/map abstentions, and source and output hashes. If map validity is incomplete, separate missing geometry/inference coverage from valid zero predictions; do not condition the primary score on positive prediction values.
label_readout.uncertainty: Paired block resampling on common pixels, block_px107 (~1mm),300draws,seed20261007 if available. Report interval and number of occupied blocks. One dense patch and a small number of blocks do not justify population significance, FPR, power, or cross-scroll generalization claims.
label_readout.subset_limit: Surfacefix interleaved-row selection/held-back points are correlated local checks. The two contiguous label-audit halves are descriptive spatial strata, not independent-sheet replications.
label_readout.final_render: Any accepted geometry must be officially rerendered and rerun with matched controls before an improvement claim. If no corrections pass, report unchanged output and no recovery; no extra final inference is needed.

stopping: Keep all fixed bars. If baseline/reference contrast or map coverage is inadequate, report failure/abstention; do not change offsets, thresholds, crop or reader based on these outputs. New settings require a new prospective experiment and separate audit data.
